_doc: Corrections to the level's generated data inside site 1 (Bar Harbor Waterfront), each from a survey with its reason. Applied by tools/site_fixes.py (World) to roads.json, edges.json and the manifest's building_fixes; the generated files stay regenerable and these are re-applied after them.

roads.name: Shore Path
roads.why: Assets, site 1 item 23 (2 Nov): the Inn's and Grant Park's walls were rebuilt in concrete in 2024-25 (Bar Harbor Story's photos); the path is gravel directly behind the parapet, 1.5 m landward of the wall's station line

roads.name: Shore Path
roads.why: Assets, site 1 item 24 (2 Nov): off the beach onto the cove wall's back, 1.5 m landward of its stations (the 2024-25 concrete wall)

roads.name: Shore Path
roads.why: Assets, site 1 item 24: 2 m landward of (241, 1590) -> (247, 1640), so the stacked stones lie along its seaward edge

spans.why: Assets' stretch 5 survey: a gully (ground dips to +1.6 between +5.0 and +4.9); steps, a bridge or a causeway are unknown until there is a photo, so no wall is laid along the dip
Assets, site 1 item 23: the Inn's 2024-25 concrete wall and its rail are drawn by the dock file (shore_path_inn_walls); the land-side shrubs stay
Assets, site 1 item 23: Grant Park's 2024-25 concrete wall is drawn by the dock file; the picket fence stays
Assets, site 1 item 24: the cove wall (2024-25 concrete) is the dock file's; the picket fence goes along it
Assets, site 1 item 24: the Reef Point wall is the dock file's; the picket fence goes along it
Assets, site 1 item 24: the Reef Point south wall is the dock file's; the picket fence goes along it
Assets, site 1 item 24: the last stretch wall (granite) is the dock file's; the picket fence goes along it
